children: US Big + Tall apparel retailer's fiscal Q2 sales fell 3.4% yr/yr, comparable sales down 3.5%
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q2 rose to $0.05 from $0.01 yr/yr
Company withdrew from proposed merger with FullBeauty, citing concerns over FullBeauty's performance
Company expects fiscal 2026 marketing costs to be about 5.8% of sales
Company sees fiscal 2026 capital expenditures at $8 mln-$10 mln, down from prior $9 mln-$12 mln
Company estimates tariffs to impact fiscal 2026 gross margin by about 100 basis points if current rates remain
LOWER STORE TRAFFIC - Co said sales decline was primarily due to decreased store traffic as consumers remained cautious amid inflation, higher energy costs, and economic uncertainty
TARIFF REFUND - Net income and gross margin benefited from a $4.6 mln tariff refund received in the quarter
GLP-1 MEDICATION IMPACT - Co said use of GLP-1 and similar weight-loss medications among customers is contributing to structural changes in demand
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Destination XL Group Inc is $1.50, about 138.1% above its September 8 closing price of $0.63
